reuse.why: Category selection and mutation wrappers reuse existing abstractions, but setLastMonthSpending bypasses the spreadsheet spending totals and averageToBudget.

duplication.why: The new action duplicates transaction aggregation from base.ts and the income-versus-expense sign conversion from averageToBudget.

placement.why: Selection policy and handler registration follow existing module boundaries, although spending aggregation belongs with the existing totals implementation.

scope.why: The changes remain focused on the requested month-wide actions, their arguments, registration, tests, and release notes.

maintainability.why: Centralized exclusions make future selection changes straightforward, but the parallel aggregation and sign implementations create avoidable maintenance responsibilities.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts:setLastMonthSpending queries transaction totals directly instead of consuming sum-amount cells through getSheetValue, and performs sign conversion instead of calling averageToBudget.

disguised_duplication.where: setLastMonthSpending reshapes base.ts spending aggregation into a single-month query and expresses averageToBudget's sign conversion through a reversed conditional.

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkBudgetCategories replaces the existing includeHidden parameter with includeHiddenCategories and adds template and fixed-group exclusion branches; setLastMonthSpending reuses selection but bypasses existing spending-total and sign-conversion abstractions.
